items.title: Trustworthy Recursive Self-Improvement with Statistical Guarantees
items.title_zh: 具有统计保证的可信递归自我改进
items.summary: TRUST adapts an online multiple-hypothesis-testing procedure to gate updates in recursive self-improvement, controlling the rate of false evolution across rounds while an LLM analyzes historical context to decide how much evidence is needed. On HotpotQA, DROP and APPS with DeepSeek-V4-Flash and Qwen-3.8-Flash, it cuts the average ratio of accepted inferior updates from 45.59% under a greedy gate to 2.78% while achieving higher final scores than statistical-gate baselines.

items.title: Learning Biological Hierarchies in Single-Cell Foundation Models
items.title_zh: 单细胞基础模型中的生物层级学习
items.summary: scOntoFM is a biologically informed single-cell foundation model that embeds hierarchical cell-ontology structure into representation learning using Lowest Common Ancestor distances and offline triplet sampling. The authors report consistent gains across cell- and gene-level benchmarks, especially in zero-shot settings, while balancing batch integration with biological structure preservation.

items.title: How reliable is an embedding of the seabed? Repeat-look measurement of frozen encoders on synthetic aperture sonar
items.title_zh: 海底嵌入有多可靠？合成孔径声呐上冻结编码器的重复观测测量
items.summary: The paper treats embeddings of synthetic-aperture sonar imagery as repeat measurements and measures the repeat-look reliability of a frozen DINOv3 ViT-S/16 encoder. Standard single-look metrics and a coral linear probe (AUC 0.93) remain stable, yet the embeddings' distance-based intraclass correlation is only 0.20, so patch-identity uses such as cross-pass retrieval fail while habitat-level classification still works.

items.title: Hybrid Source Code Change Impact Analysis
items.title_zh: 混合式源代码变更影响分析
items.summary: katIA combines static impact analysis with LLM refinement in a single-prompt variant and a three-agent variant, evaluated on a manually labeled set of 1,931 changed entities from 263 commits in 22 Java projects. With Gemini 2.5 Flash, the single-prompt variant reaches 27.0% F1 on class-and-entity matching, 2.0 points above the prior state of the art, and the multi-agent variant raises it to 33.3% at higher latency and token use.

items.title: BlenderFORGE: Framework for Optimizing Reactive 3D-Graphics Editing Ability of MLLMs
items.title_zh: BlenderFORGE：优化多模态大模型反应式 3D 图形编辑能力的框架
items.summary: BlenderFORGE is a trainable data-environment-optimization framework for open-weight MLLM agents that edit Blender scenes by generating Blender Python code, covering object placement, shape-key editing, lighting and materials. It combines perturbation-based data generation, an isolated Blender sandbox with state export and reward computation, and a two-stage pipeline of teacher-trajectory SFT followed by sandbox-reward agentic RL, reporting gains for Qwen3-VL-8B and Qwen3.5-9B agents.

items.title: drost-ai/tinker-ai-skill
items.title_zh: tinker-ai-skill：用个人 Claude Code 会话微调代理模型
items.summary: tinker-ai-skill is an agent skill for fine-tuning an agentic model on a user's own Claude Code sessions with Tinker, compatible with Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode.

items.title: dabingfy-dot/solo-to-team-skills
items.title_zh: solo-to-team-skills：一人统筹多智能体协作的工具包
items.summary: solo-to-team-skills is a human-led multi-agent toolkit with 16 roles, six group templates, four platform bundles, and evidence-based review and handoff, described as letting one person coordinate a team of agents.

items.title: thecoderrrer/ai_manus
items.title_zh: ai_manus：通用 AI 代理系统
items.summary: AI Manus is a general-purpose AI agent system that can run various tools and operations in a sandboxed environment.

items.title: PIA: Agentic Physics-Informed Runtime Anomaly Detection
items.title_zh: PIA：智能体驱动的物理信息运行时异常检测
items.summary: PIA has an LLM agent write physical-residual detectors and refine them against normal operating data; on BATADAL it reaches F1 0.878 versus 0.504 for the strongest baseline and attributes each alarm to a component.
